address.description: Control channel address: `unix:///path/to/socket` or `http(s)://host:port`. Falls back to `KEA_DHCP4_ADDRESS` environment variable.

http_password.description: Password for HTTP basic authentication. Falls back to `KEA_DHCP4_HTTP_PASSWORD` environment variable.

http_username.description: Username for HTTP basic authentication. Falls back to `KEA_DHCP4_HTTP_USERNAME` environment variable.

dhcp4.description: Connection settings for the Kea DHCPv4 server.

block.description: The Kea provider enables management of Kea DHCP server resources via the control channel API. It connects to Kea servers using UNIX domain sockets or HTTP/HTTPS endpoints.

boot_file_name.description: Boot file name for network booting (`file` field in DHCP packet, Option 67).

circuit_id.description: Circuit ID (Option 82 sub-option 1) to identify the client. Typically inserted by relay agents. Mutually exclusive with other identifier types.

client_classes.description: Client classes to assign to this client.

client_id.description: Client identifier (Option 61) to identify the client. Mutually exclusive with other identifier types.

duid.description: DHCP Unique Identifier. Typically used in DHCPv6 but also supported for DHCPv4. Mutually exclusive with other identifier types.

flex_id.description: Flexible identifier from the `flex_id` hook library. Mutually exclusive with other identifier types.

hostname.description: Hostname to assign to the client.

hw_address.description: Hardware (MAC) address to identify the client. Mutually exclusive with other identifier types.

id.description: Unique identifier for the reservation in the format `{subnet_id}/{identifier_type}/{identifier}`.

ip_address.description: IPv4 address to reserve for this client.

next_server.description: Next server address for network booting (`siaddr` field in DHCP packet).

server_hostname.description: Server hostname for network booting (`sname` field in DHCP packet).

subnet_id.description: Subnet ID for this reservation, or `0` for a global reservation.

user_context.description: Arbitrary JSON data stored with this reservation.

always_send.description: Always send this option, even if not requested by the client.

client_classes.description: Only send this option to clients in these classes.

code.description: Option code (0-255). Required if `name` is not set.

csv_format.description: When `true` (default), data is comma-separated values. When `false`, data is raw bytes as hex (`dead` or `0xdead`), colon/space-delimited octets (`de:ad` or `de ad`), or a quoted string (`'text'`).

name.description: Option name (e.g., `domain-name-servers`). Required if `code` is not set.

never_send.description: Never send this option to the client.

block.description: DHCP options to send to this client, overriding subnet and global options.

Manages a DHCPv4 host reservation in the Kea DHCP server. Host reservations bind specific IP addresses and DHCP options to clients identified by MAC address, client ID, or other identifiers.

**Important:** Requires the `host_cmds` hook library and a hosts database backend.
